QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_18

question.text: Minimum investment from every investor in a Cat III AIF is INR 1 crore. This minimum is NOT applicable to:

explanation.text: The Logic: Accredited Investors are EXEMPT from the INR 1 crore minimum investment requirement. Sponsor/IM must still meet continuing-interest thresholds (their own rule). Family trusts and FPIs are NOT in the exemption list. The Trap: Sponsor/IM (A) follow a separate continuing-interest rule. Family trusts (C) must meet the 1 cr floor. FPIs (D) have no special minimum-investment exemption under AIF Regs. Note: The workbook fixes the INR 1 crore minimum-ticket rule and the accredited-investor exemption; institutional-only launch and LVF structuring advice is not part of the syllabus.
